title: Tempban Appeal part 4

replies.author: Camemes
replies.body:
G'day.
This isn't the first time you have cursed in these channels either. You knew you messed up after you said it so therefore you were temporarily banned for 1 hour. I have multiple witnesses who saw you curse in this channel multiple times, the punishment will stay and this appeal, denied.
If you have any evidence to suggest it was false, I am open to it but until then you will remain banned.

Cheers,
{tag=bff56e079469477281be84fc627ea113}
